About

I'm a 2025 Electronics & Communication Engineering graduate from Matrusri Engineering College, Osmania University, now focused fully on analytics. My path started in embedded systems and a quantum computing research internship — work that trained me to sit with messy, ambiguous data and pull structured findings out of it.

That instinct carried straight into data analysis. I've since cleaned and analyzed 23,486 e-commerce reviews and 12,316 road-accident records in Python, and written SQL for engagement reporting — always translating raw numbers into something a stakeholder can act on in under a minute.

I pair traditional analyst tooling — Excel, SQL, Power BI, Tableau — with AI/LLM-assisted workflows to move faster without cutting corners on accuracy.

Projects

Three projects. Zero guesswork.

Hands-on projects built to mirror real analytics-team work — from cleaning raw records to findings, automation and query-ready reporting.

Python · Gen AI

Customer Feedback Analysis & Automated Response

2026 · 23,486 e-commerce reviews View on GitHub ↗
  • Cleaned 23,486 e-commerce reviews in Pandas and isolated 2,370 critical (1–2 star) reviews using rule-based Python logic, with no machine learning.
  • Analyzed complaints with collections.Counter and custom stop-word lists; sizing and fit issues appeared in 69% of critical reviews.
  • Engineered Gemini API prompts to draft personalized apology emails for the 3 most detailed 1-star reviews.
PythonPandascollections.CounterGemini APIPrompt Engineering
Python · EDA

Road Traffic Accident (RTA) Analysis — Severity EDA

2026 · 12,316 records, 32 columns View on GitHub ↗
  • Cleaned and validated 12,316 records across 32 columns in Pandas, handling missing values, duplicates and invalid ranges.
  • Engineered Hour, Time_Period and Is_Weekend features and ran univariate to multivariate EDA with Matplotlib and Seaborn.
  • Found accidents peak at 17:00 and on Fridays; darkness with no road lighting showed a ~28% serious/fatal rate vs ~15% in daylight.
PythonPandasMatplotlibSeabornFeature Engineering
